checks.name: real IndexedDB state round-trip and UTF-8 profile
snapshot captured before a queued caller mutation
export/import/copy/delete preserve world and unrelated slots
aborted transaction preserves the last verified revision
quota exception preserves current and previous revisions
corrupt current revision falls back, quarantines and preserves prior state
future schema refuses downgrade even with a valid previous revision
independent repository instances reject stale concurrent writes
migration is atomic, retryable and retains frozen source bytes
authentic v2 save migrates through an explicit journal to schema3
invalid import never overwrites a valid existing slot
twenty measured saves and loads preserve canonical state
old TC SIM, Boardworld and Racon namespace canaries stay byte-identical
close/reopen keeps the authoritative state frozen
closing a tab during an active write preserves the last committed state
